title: Self-service ordering: the kiosk journey with a foyer host
subtitle: Five stages from the door to the hand-off, with the foyer host as its own frontstage lane. The measures lane says what counts as done; the failure points are where the channel broke before the role existed.

lanes.name: Guest (frontstage)
cells: Greeted within seconds || Before the redesign nobody owned the space between the door and the machine.
Guided first order || Help to navigate, never judge, and the counter offered as an equal path.
Card at the kiosk || Kiosks take no cash by design; cash guests go to the counter queue.
Waits at the pick-up queue || The collection screen shows order status; delays are acknowledged.
Order verified at hand-off || The presenter confirms the order; the feedback link is on the receipt.

lanes.name: Foyer host (frontstage)
cells: Greeting and the cash-or-card ask || No guest enters ungreeted; cash and specific-piece requests are sent to the counter.
Assists; runs the pre-peak checks || Menu synced, collection screen working, kiosks cleaned, receipt and payment stock ready.
Cash path to the counter || Cash guests are never abandoned at the machine.
Ready flip within the order-to-collect rule || The order is flipped to ready inside the standard.
Hand-off and parting recognition || The guest leaves recognised, not ignored: the moment that drives the feedback theme.

lanes.name: Restaurant (backstage)
cells: Rostering and cleanliness || The foyer host is a rostered role the time and attendance platform now supports; hourly high-touch cleaning.
Order to the till system; menu sync || Availability refreshed nightly; express-kiosk exclusions and mismatches scripted.
Payment state verified || Pin-pad timeouts and failed payments have defined responses.
Kitchen display and packer || One packer or presenter per redeployed cashier.
Collect and recover || First-line ladder: retry, error-code catalogue, manager reboot, stand-alone reprint.

lanes.name: Measures
cells: Greet rate; cash routed || Every guest greeted at peak; cash guests routed, not turned away.
Assisted first order completes || Guided first order inside the standard time.
Counter wait inside the golden rule || Guest through the system inside the standard.
Order-to-collect inside the rule || Ready flip measured per order.
Feedback theme mix || Staff recognition the top positive theme.

lanes.name: Failure points
cells: F-01 No one owns the door || Nobody greets; first-timers abandon.
F-02 No channel training || Order-taking courses had no self-service content.
F-03 Cash guests excluded || Long counter waits; guests turned away from the channel.
F-04 Failed kiosk ends the visit || Help-desk dependent; no first-line recovery.
F-05 Foyer cleanliness unowned || The most negative feedback cluster.

footer: KFC South Pacific, 2023 to 2024. Drawn by Sam Mozaffari from the engagement's order workflow; vendors, sites and people removed. Rendered September 2026.
